title: [review] provisioning.py:343: Error codes create oracle desp
description: Lines 343-345 return UNAUTHORIZED for DecryptionFailedError, while lines 346-348 return BAD_REQUEST for other ProvisioningError. This contradicts the comment at line 296 about 'generic error to prevent oracle attacks'. An attacker can distinguish AEAD authentication failure (UNAUTHORIZED) from decode/validation errors (BAD_REQUEST). Same pattern at lines 383-389 for node POST handler. Both should return the same code.
